categories.name: SPL22
categories.content: SPL22 is a hybrid token extension of the Solana blockchain that combines the features of both fungible and non-fungible tokens.

categories.name: Sun Pump Ecosystem
categories.content: Sun Pump Ecosystem consists of tokens launched via sunpump.meme.

categories.name: Bridged DAI
categories.content: Bridged DAI refers to DAI that has been transferred from its native blockchain to a different blockchain through "bridging'.

categories.name: Bridged Stablecoin
categories.content: Bridged stablecoin refers to a stablecoin that has been transferred, or “bridged,” from one blockchain to another, typically through the use of a blockchain bridge.

categories.name: daos.fun Ecosystem
categories.content: daos.fun Ecosystem consists of tokens that have active hedge funds on daos.fun.

categories.name: Market-Making Solution
categories.content: A Market-Making Solution refers to a service that enhances liquidity in markets by consistently offering buy and sell orders.

categories.name: Pools.fun Ecosystem
categories.content: Pools.fun Ecosystem consists of tokens launched via pools.fun

categories.name: ERC20i
categories.content: ERC20i is a token standard on Base blockchain that extends the capabilities of ERC-20 tokens by adding native inscriptions.

categories.name: TRON Meme
categories.content: Meme coins native to the TRON network.

categories.name: Pools Launchpad
categories.content: Tokens launched through Pools (https://pools.trade/), Uniswap's first-party token issuance platform.

categories.name: Cookie Launchpad
categories.content: Cookie Launchpad is a token sale platform operated by Cookie DAO that allocates participation opportunities in three pools: one for top users ranked by on-chain and social engagement ('capital mindshare' via Cookie Snaps), one for $COOKIE token stakers in higher tiers, and a public first-come-first-served pool.

categories.name: Printr Launchpad
categories.content: Printr is chain-abstracted token launchpad with customizable fee models and an on-chain 'Proof of Belief' staking mechanism that rewards long-term community commitment.

categories.name: Moonshot Ecosystem
categories.content: Moonshot Ecosystem consists of tokens launched via https://moonshot.money/.

categories.name: Zora Creator
categories.content: Zora Creator Coins are profile-level tokens on the Zora platform, a blockchain-based social network focused on the creator economy. Each Zora account has its own unique Creator Coin, represented by the user's username as the ticker symbol (e.g., $username).

categories.name: Bridged-Tokens
categories.content: Bridged-tokens refers to a token that has been transferred or "bridged" from one blockchain to another, typically through the use of a blockchain bridge.

categories.name: Layer 3 (L3)
categories.content: Layer 3 protocols are built on Layer 2, enabling hosting of application-specific decentralized applications while addressing issues such as scalability, interoperability and customization.

categories.name: Moltbook and Openclaw-Themed
categories.content: The Moltbook and Openclaw-Themed category features community-driven assets representing specific agent personas or viral narratives (memes) within the Moltbook platform.

categories.name: Anime-Themed
categories.content: Meme coins which are inspired by anime.

categories.name: Privacy Browser
categories.content: A privacy browser is a browser built or hardened to block trackers, ads, fingerprinting, and data leaks by default, keeping your activity more private from websites and advertisers.
